theorem_title: Positive naturals factor into a power of three and a unit
natural_language_statement:
For every natural $n>0$,

$$
\exists e,u\in\mathbb N,\quad u>0,\quad u\not\equiv0\pmod3,\quad3^e u=n.
$$

This existence lemma supplies the normalized factorization needed by the divisibility-form ancestor theorem.
formal_statement:
theorem CollatzWork.residueAncestor_factor_unit (n : Nat) :
    0 < n → ∃ e u : Nat, 0 < u ∧ u % 3 ≠ 0 ∧ 3 ^ e * u = n := by sorry
